notes.md: - **Human Rights Day themes:** **2016** "Stand up for someone's rights today"; **2024** "Our Rights, Our Future, Right Now"; **2025** "**Human Rights, Our Everyday Essentials**".

- **Amnesty report 2025 (May 2026):** at least **2,707** executions in **17** countries, the highest since **1981** (1,518 in 2024); **Iran** led with **2,159+**, then Saudi Arabia; **China** is excluded (state secret) but remains the top executioner.

new.s: According to the Tendulkar Expert Group, what was the poverty ratio in India in 2004-05?
new.x: The Tendulkar method put poverty at 37.2% in 2004-05 and 21.9% in 2011-12.
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: Tendulkar 2004-05 estimate 37.2%

new.s: Which expert group's method gave a poverty estimate of 27.5% for 2004-05?
new.x: The Lakdawala method (state-specific lines with CPI-AL / CPI-IW) gave 27.5% poverty for 2004-05.
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: Lakdawala 2004-05 estimate 27.5%

new.s: What were the monthly per capita poverty lines for 2011-12 set by the Rangarajan Expert Group for rural and urban areas respectively?
new.x: Rangarajan's lines were ₹972 (rural) and ₹1,407 (urban) a month, i.e. about ₹32 and ₹47 a day.
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: Rangarajan monthly lines ₹972/₹1,407

new.s: Which expert group was set up in 2009 to recommend the method of identifying urban BPL households?
new.x: The S.R. Hashim group (2009) dealt with urban BPL households; N.C. Saxena dealt with the rural BPL census.
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: Hashim group -> urban BPL

new.s: Which expert group on poverty adopted the Mixed Reference Period (MRP) and used the urban consumption basket for both rural and urban areas?
new.x: The Tendulkar group (report 2009) adopted MRP, used the urban basket for both sectors and dropped the calorie anchor.
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: Tendulkar -> MRP, urban basket

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Tendulkar Expert Group:
1. It adopted the Mixed Reference Period (MRP).
2. It fixed calorie norms of 2,400 for rural and 2,100 for urban areas.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Tendulkar adopted MRP and dropped the calorie anchor; the 2,400 / 2,100 calorie norms were the Alagh Task Force's (1979).
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: Tendulkar MRP vs Alagh calories

new.s: As per the Periodic Labour Force Survey, what was India's unemployment rate in 2023-24?
new.x: PLFS shows India's unemployment rate fell from 6.0% (2017-18) to 3.2% (2023-24).
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: India unemployment rate 3.2% (PLFS 2023-24)

new.s: As per PLFS 2023-24, what was the labour force participation rate (LFPR) of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: PLFS 2023-24 put Andhra Pradesh's LFPR at 47.5%.
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: AP LFPR 47.5%

new.s: In the NITI Aayog National MPI 2023, what was Andhra Pradesh's rank with a poverty headcount of 6.06%?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh had an MPI headcount of 6.06% and was ranked 9th (NITI MPI 2023).
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: AP MPI rank 9th

new.s: As per the NITI Aayog National MPI 2023 (2019-21 data), what was India's multidimensional poverty headcount?
new.x: India's headcount was 14.96%; Andhra Pradesh 6.06%; Bihar the highest at 33.76%.
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: India MPI headcount 14.96%

new.s: Which programmes were merged to form the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY) in 1999?
new.x: SGSY (1999) merged IRDP, DWCRA, TRYSEM and others into one SHG-based self-employment scheme.
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: SGSY merged IRDP, DWCRA, TRYSEM

new.s: Through which body is the credit-linked subsidy under the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP, 2008) given?
new.x: PMEGP merged PMRY and REGP and gives a credit-linked subsidy through the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC).
new.angle: U0397 notes gap: PMEGP -> KVIC

new.s: When did the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR) enter into force?
new.x: The ICCPR, adopted on 16 December 1966, entered into force on 23 March 1976, after the ICESCR (3 January 1976).
new.angle: U0398 notes gap: ICCPR in force 23 March 1976

new.s: What was the theme of Human Rights Day observed on 10 December 2025?
o: Our Rights, Our Future, Right Now
Stand up for someone's rights today
Dignity, Freedom and Justice for All
new.x: The UN theme for Human Rights Day 2025 was 'Human Rights, Our Everyday Essentials'; 2024's was 'Our Rights, Our Future, Right Now'.
new.angle: U0398 web: Human Rights Day -> theme (PYQ angle)

new.s: In which year was 'Stand up for someone's rights today' the theme of Human Rights Day?
new.x: 'Stand up for someone's rights today' was the slogan of Human Rights Day 2016, launched by the UN Human Rights Office.
new.angle: U0398 web: Human Rights Day theme -> year (PYQ angle)

new.s: In which case was the right to free legal aid read into Article 21?
new.x: M.H. Hoskot (1978) read legal aid into Article 21; Hussainara Khatoon is speedy trial, Olga Tellis livelihood.
new.angle: U0399 notes gap: Hoskot -> legal aid

new.s: 'Public servant' under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 has the meaning in Section 21 of the IPC. Which BNS provision replaced it from 1 July 2024?
new.x: The IPC Section 21 definition of public servant is now Section 2(28) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
new.angle: U0399 notes gap: PHRA public servant -> BNS s.2(28)

new.s: Which Constitutional Amendment inserted Article 15(4), enabling special provisions for backward classes, SCs and STs?
new.x: Article 15(4) was added by the Constitution (First Amendment) Act, 1951.
new.angle: U0399 notes gap: Art 15(4) -> First Amendment

new.s: When did the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 come into force?
new.x: The SC/ST Atrocities Act of 1989 came into force on 30 January 1990.
new.angle: U0399 notes gap: SC/ST Atrocities Act in force 30 Jan 1990

new.s: When did the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 receive the President's assent?
new.x: The ordinance came on 28 September 1993 and the NHRC was constituted on 12 October 1993; the Act got assent in January 1994.
new.angle: U0400 notes gap: PHRA assent January 1994

new.s: The Chairperson of the National Commission for Backward Classes is a deemed member of the NHRC. By which Constitutional Amendment did the NCBC get constitutional status?
new.x: The NCBC, set up by an Act in 1993, got constitutional status by the 102nd Amendment (2018).
new.angle: U0400 notes gap: NCBC constitutional status -> 102nd Amendment

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the removal of the NHRC Chairperson:
1. The President can remove the Chairperson directly if he is adjudged an insolvent.
2. Removal for proved misbehaviour or incapacity needs an inquiry by the Supreme Court on the President's reference.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Insolvency, paid outside employment, infirmity, unsound mind and moral-turpitude conviction allow direct removal; misbehaviour or incapacity needs a Supreme Court inquiry.
new.angle: U0400 notes gap: #1 NHRC removal grounds (direct vs SC inquiry)

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a ground on which the President may remove the Chairperson of the NHRC?
o: Engaging in paid employment outside the duties of office
Conviction for an offence involving moral turpitude
Being of unsound mind as declared by a competent court
Disagreeing with the policies of the Union Government
new.x: The Act lists insolvency, paid outside employment, infirmity, unsound mind, moral-turpitude conviction, and proved misbehaviour or incapacity; policy disagreement is not a ground.
new.angle: U0400 notes gap: #1 NHRC removal grounds (NOT)

new.s: In a State having a Legislative Council, who are added to the committee that recommends the SHRC Chairperson and members?
o: Chairman and Leader of Opposition of the Legislative Council
Chief Justice of the High Court and Advocate General
Governor and Deputy Speaker of the Assembly
Chief Secretary and Director General of Police
new.x: The CM-led committee has the Speaker, State Home Minister and LoP in the Assembly; where there is a Council, its Chairman and LoP are added.
new.angle: U0400 notes gap: #19 SHRC selection committee (bicameral)

new.s: Which of the following is NOT part of the NHRC norms on custodial deaths?
o: Reporting the death to the NHRC within 24 hours
Investigation only by officers of the same police station
new.x: NHRC norms require a report within 24 hours, post-mortem videography and an independent investigation.
new.angle: U0400 notes gap: #9 custodial death norms (videography)

new.s: The NHRC's Advisory 2.0 issued in May 2026 concerns the welfare of which group?
new.x: Advisory 2.0 (May 2026) is on transgender welfare: Census categories, legal-aid cells and Garima Greh expansion.
new.angle: U0400 notes gap: NHRC specialised mandate: transgender Advisory 2.0

new.s: Which of the following is a function of the NHRC under Section 12 of the Protection of Human Rights Act?
o: Reviewing factors, including acts of terrorism, that inhibit the enjoyment of human rights
Punishing public servants found guilty of violations
Appointing the Chairpersons of State Human Rights Commissions
Framing laws on human rights for Parliament
new.x: Section 12 lets the NHRC review safeguards and factors such as terrorism that inhibit human rights; it cannot punish or legislate.
new.angle: U0400 notes gap: #17 functions: review factors incl. terrorism

new.s: The Gade Sai Krishna custodial death case in Andhra Pradesh involved the police of which station?
new.x: Gade Sai Krishna died in the custody of Krishnalanka police, Vijayawada; the NHRC sought reports from the AP SHRC, DGP and Chief Secretary.
new.angle: U0401 notes gap: AP custodial death: Krishnalanka, Vijayawada

new.s: According to NCRB Prison Statistics 2024, how many prisons were there in India?
new.x: NCRB Prison Statistics 2024: 1,333 prisons, capacity about 4.53 lakh and 5.11 lakh inmates.
new.angle: U0401 notes gap: #1 NCRB prisons count 1,333

new.s: According to NCRB Prison Statistics 2024, how many exclusive women's prisons does India have?
new.x: Women are 4.14% of inmates and India has only 34 women's prisons (NCRB Prison Statistics 2024).
new.angle: U0401 notes gap: #1 NCRB women's prisons 34

new.s: What did the Supreme Court hold about the solitary confinement of death-row convicts in Shatrughan Chauhan v Union of India (2014)?
o: It is mandatory after rejection of mercy
It is allowed for up to 14 days
It is left to the Governor
new.x: Shatrughan Chauhan held solitary confinement illegal, allowed commutation for inordinate delay and required 14 days before execution.
new.angle: U0401 notes gap: #8 Shatrughan Chauhan -> solitary confinement illegal

new.s: According to Amnesty International, in how many countries were executions carried out in 2017?
new.x: Amnesty recorded executions in 23 countries in 2017, with China the biggest executioner.
new.angle: U0401 notes gap: #2 Amnesty 2017: 23 countries

new.s: According to Amnesty International's report 'Death Sentences and Executions 2025', which country carried out the most recorded executions in 2025, excluding China?
new.x: Iran executed at least 2,159 people in 2025, followed by Saudi Arabia (356+); China's figure is a state secret and not counted.
new.angle: U0401 web: #2 Amnesty global execution ranking (2025)

new.s: At least how many executions did Amnesty International record worldwide (excluding China) in 2025, its highest figure since 1981?
new.x: Amnesty recorded at least 2,707 executions in 17 countries in 2025, up 78% from 1,518 in 2024.
new.angle: U0401 web: #2 Amnesty executions total 2025

new.s: In the Vedic period, by which term was the wife honoured as the 'better half' of her husband?
new.x: In the early Vedic period women had an honourable place; the wife was called 'Ardhangini' (better half).
new.angle: U0402 notes gap: #11 Vedic status: Ardhangini

new.s: With which newspaper is Raja Rammohan Roy associated?

new.s: With which school, founded in 1849 for girls' education, is Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar associated?

new.s: In which year did Durgabai Deshmukh found the Andhra Mahila Sabha?

new.s: What is the minimum punishment under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 for giving or taking dowry?
o: 5 years and fine of ₹15,000 or the value of dowry, whichever is more

new.s: When did the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 come into force?

new.s: As of 31 July 2025, how many Family Courts were functioning in India under the Family Courts Act, 1984?

new.s: In which district was India's first exclusive women's court set up in 2013?

new.s: In which Five-Year Plan did the approach to women shift from 'development' to 'empowerment'?

new.s: Along with the Allahabad High Court's Rahmatullah case (1994), which 2002 Supreme Court case is cited as an early ruling against arbitrary triple talaq?
new.x: Before Shayara Bano (2017), Rahmatullah (Allahabad HC, 1994) and Shamim Ara (SC, 2002) held arbitrary triple talaq invalid.
new.angle: U0402 notes gap: #21 Shamim Ara (2002)
